title: AARYA Voice Lab Stage Result
description: Execution metadata emitted by every pipeline stage. This is the filesystem contract between stages that run in mutually incompatible Python environments (see docs/COMPATIBILITY.md). It records what ran, where, on what input, and with what outcome, so a stage can be resumed, audited, or reproduced without re-running its predecessors.

stage.description: PipelineStage value this result belongs to.

status.description: 'blocked' means a stop condition (credential/gated model/external service) prevented execution — distinct from 'failed'.

environment_id.description: Which isolated environment executed this stage (e.g. 'env-nemo'). Critical for reproducibility because stages run under different PyTorch versions.

processing_version.description: Version of the AARYA Voice Lab code that produced this result.

hardware.description: Hardware the stage ran on; results are only comparable across matching hardware.

inputs.description: Input artifacts with content hashes, enabling change detection and resumability.

path.description: Path relative to the run directory. Never an absolute path into private source material.

sha256.description: Content hash. Lets a stage detect that its input is unchanged and skip re-work.
